answer: Work waits on the dune until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the canyon of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the cedar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
